name: ecollab-frontend-quality
description: Review and improve E-Collab frontend quality while preserving its existing visual language, accessibility, responsive behavior, and vanilla JS architecture.
---

# Frontend Quality

Inspect existing design patterns before changing UI. Verify hierarchy, spacing, typography, states, keyboard accessibility, focus, responsive behavior, loading/empty/error states, and consistency with neighboring pages.

Do not introduce a new framework or redesign working screens without a requirement. Validate both visual behavior and the API/data state that drives it. Pair with webapp-testing for browser verification.
